body: Rule (approved 31 Oct): when you go through a door, bear and seal sit or lie by it and join you again when you come out. At the vet station they come in.

comments.text:
Done: they sit or lie by the door and rejoin you.
Leftover: the player fades out at the door.

short: Bear and seal wait by the door. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: gap check against the stage briefs
title: Bear and seal wait outside buildings
